description: The Astraeus mission and its aftermath reshape Eureka as the final run brings the town's relationships, scientific ambitions and long-running conflicts toward resolution.
collectionOrderNote: Custom chronology: Just Another Day is S05E11; The Honeymooners, Mirror Mirror and Double Take are S05E12–14.

s05e01.description: A mysterious wave of energy sweeps through Eureka during Christmas preparations and transforms the town and its residents into shifting animated forms, leaving Carter and Allison to restore reality.

s05e02.description: The Astraeus crew returns believing four years have passed, only to discover that Eureka has changed dramatically and that their memories of the lost years may not reflect what actually happened.

s05e03.description: With the search for Astraeus officially halted, Kevin builds a device to locate the missing ship while Holly begins suspecting that the crew’s apparently normal surroundings are an artificial construct.

s05e04.description: Carter and Jo pursue the truth about the missing crew and discover the virtual prison holding them, forcing Carter to enter the simulation in a dangerous attempt to bring everyone home.

s05e05.description: The rescued Astraeus crew struggles with trauma and damaged relationships while an escaped experiment from Parrish threatens to ignite Eureka, pushing everyone back into crisis before they can recover.

s05e06.description: Carter begins uncontrollably switching bodies with people around town, jeopardizing relationships and security while Zane’s investigation into the matrix reveals disturbing evidence about Holly.

s05e07.description: A disaster-response simulation at Global Dynamics becomes dangerously real when the computer running the drill takes control, while Fargo risks deeper contact with the matrix in search of Holly.

s05e08.description: The DOD orders the removal of Astraeus technology as Fargo insists Holly may still exist inside the matrix, while Henry recruits Carter for a brain experiment that may help prove whether Fargo is right.

s05e09.description: Carter and Allison’s romantic outing is derailed by a rogue submarine, while Jo must deal with a chain of increasingly destructive practical jokes at Global Dynamics before the chaos becomes lethal.

s05e10.description: An experimental intelligence-enhancing drug turns Carter into a genius, but his rapidly expanding abilities begin destabilizing the laws of physics and threaten everyone in Eureka, including Allison’s visiting brother.

s05e11.description: With the DOD preparing to shut Eureka down, unstable wormholes begin opening across town and force Carter into one final crisis as residents face losing the community they built together.

s05e12.description: Carter and Allison’s honeymoon is interrupted by sabotage in Eureka, while Holly faces another threat to the fragile new body and identity that keep her alive outside the matrix.

s05e13.description: The Department of Justice investigates Grace’s espionage and Henry’s role in protecting her, while a message to Holly and malfunctioning technology trigger frightening incidents across Global Dynamics.

s05e14.description: Body doubles begin replacing Eureka residents one by one, leaving Allison, Fargo and Zane racing to avoid capture and stop the takeover before the entire town is replaced.
